name: step ladder
definition: free-standing hinged A-frame ladder.
notes: Sold as step ladders with swingback and handrail variants.

name: platform step ladder
definition: step ladder with a top platform to stand on.
notes: Platform step ladders sold as own group (Lyte MagnaStep, TB Davies HORIZON, Zarges GRP).

name: combination ladder
definition: ladder that can be set up in more than one form (step, extension, other) from one set of rails.
notes: Combination ladders filter (37) at Toolstation; 3-in-1, 4-in-1, 12-way versions.

name: extension ladder
definition: ladder with sliding sections that lean against a support.
notes: Extension ladders have own category (Toolstation, 47 products); double and triple section.

name: telescopic ladder
definition: ladder whose rungs and rails telescope into each other.
notes: Telescopic ladders have own category (Toolstation, 13 products).

name: trolley jack
definition: wheeled hydraulic floor jack with a lifting arm.
notes: Trolley Jack is a type filter on Toolstation jacks page.

name: bottle jack
definition: hydraulic jack in a vertical bottle form.
notes: Bottle Jack is a type filter; hydraulic bottle jacks 2 to 12 tonne.

name: axle stand
definition: stand that supports a lifted vehicle.
notes: Draper Ratcheting Axle Stands; Stands filter on the page.

name: engine hoist
definition: folding crane that lifts engines.
notes: Engine Hoist type filter; Hilka Engine Crane 1 Tonne.

name: chain hoist
definition: hand or electric hoist with a chain.
notes: Hilka Heavy Duty Chain Block 2000kg and Hilka Electric Hoist 250kg listed.

name: winch
definition: drum and rope or cable device for pulling or lifting.
notes: Winches listed: Hilka Vehicle Winch 12V, Streetwize Pull Winch 4000kg.

name: sack truck [hand truck]
definition: upright two-wheel carrier with a toe plate for tilting and moving loads.
notes: Category Sack trucks; hand truck and sack trolley used as synonyms.

name: dolly
definition: low platform carrier on wheels or casters.
notes: Dollies listed as own type (Olympia Roughneck, Barton plywood dolly).

name: hand cart
definition: hand-pushed multi-wheel cart or trolley for goods.
notes: Sold as folding platform trolley and utility trolley; the term hand cart not used on either page.

name: excavator
definition: machine with a boom, arm and bucket on a swinging house, tracked or wheeled (mini to full size).
notes: Mini excavators listed in Bobcat construction range.

name: skid steer loader
definition: compact loader steered by skidding wheels or tracks, with a lift arm.
notes: Skid-steer loaders and compact track loaders listed.

name: telehandler
definition: loader with a telescopic boom.
notes: Telehandlers and rotary telehandlers listed; TL40.180SLP named.

name: forklift
definition: truck that lifts loads on forks.
notes: Counterbalance forklifts (electric, diesel, LPG) sold with Hyster model ranges.

name: dumper
definition: machine with a tipping body for hauling material on site.
notes: Wheel dumper DW50 presented as a Wacker Neuson product.

name: plate compactor
definition: vibrating plate machine that compacts soil and aggregate.
notes: Vibratory plates APS, BPS and DPS series, battery, petrol and diesel.

name: cement mixer
definition: drum machine that mixes cement, mortar or concrete.
notes: The Handy 90L Electric Cement Mixer listed; page text also names petrol mixers.

name: inverter generator
definition: engine-driven generator with inverter electronics for stable output.
notes: Inverter generators category; open-frame and enclosed Super Quiet forms.

name: conventional (open-frame) portable generator
definition: engine-driven generator in an open frame with a directly coupled alternator.
notes: Draper open frame petrol generators; inverter not stated, so conventional reading only by title.

name: air compressor
definition: machine that makes compressed air for tools, in a general workshop or site role.
notes: Draper compressors 6 to 200 litre, oil-free and belt-driven; one cordless.

name: submersible (drainage) pump
definition: pump that sits under water to remove or drain it.
notes: Submersible drainage, puddle and sewage pumps listed; DAB pumps for dirty water.

name: transfer pump
definition: pump that moves liquid from one container to another.
notes: Fuel Transfer Pumps category with a Transfer subtype; drum and lever pumps.

name: battery pack
definition: rechargeable pack made for a maker's cordless tool platform.
notes: Makita LXT packs BL1820B to BL1860B sold as batteries.

name: charger
definition: charger made for a maker's cordless tool platform.
notes: Makita LXT chargers DC18RC, DC18RD, DC18SF, DC18SE.

name: portable toolbox
definition: hand-carried box for tools.
notes: Tool Boxes & Cases category with Stanley toolboxes.

name: wheeled toolbox [tool trolley]
definition: tool box on wheels with a pull handle.
notes: Stanley Rolling Wheeled Workshop with heavy-duty wheels and telescopic pull handle.

name: modular stackable tool case
definition: case that locks onto other cases of a system by cleats or latches.
notes: Stackable systems listed: PACKOUT, TSTAK, MakPac, Systainer, L-BOXX, FatMax Pro Stack.

name: tool bag
definition: soft or hard-bodied bag made to carry tools.
notes: Tool Bags & Rucksacks category (Hultafors, Ozito, Stanley bags).

name: tool roll
definition: flexible roll-up wrap for tools.
notes: Tool Rolls category; Bahco tool roll with 10 pockets.

name: roller cabinet
definition: drawered cabinet on casters.
notes: Roller Cabinets & Tool Chests category (Sealey Superline Pro).

name: tool kit
definition: assorted hand tools sold, standardised and compared as one object.
notes: Draper 100-piece tool kit: sockets, ratchets, pliers, spanners, screwdrivers in one case.

name: dust extractor [dust collector]
definition: extraction unit for dust from workshop machines and power tools.
notes: Dust extractors category with L, M and H dust class machines.

name: fume extractor
definition: unit that draws away soldering or welding fumes.
notes: Benchtop solder fume extractor with carbon filter.

name: drill bit
definition: cutting bit for a drill.
notes: Drill bits sold within bit sets and Festool CENTROTEC drill bits.

name: driver bit
definition: screwdriving bit for a drill or driver.
notes: Screwdriver bits sold in 25-packs and sets (Bosch Impact Control, Festool CENTROTEC).

name: saw blade
definition: toothed blade made for a saw.
notes: Bosch circular saw blade Expert for Wood, ATB teeth, listed per saw type.

name: grinding disc
definition: disc cut for a grinder.
notes: Makita depressed-centre disc for angle grinders; X-LOCK fits plus 22.23 mm bore.

name: sanding sheet cut for one sander
definition: sheet or disc shaped to fit one sander.
notes: Bosch EXPERT C470 discs for random orbital sanders; hook-and-loop multihole.

name: welding wire
definition: wire electrode for wire-fed welding.
notes: MIG wire category incl. Lincoln EasyArc ER70S-6 and flux-cored wire.

name: welding rod [electrode]
definition: coated or bare rod for stick or TIG welding.
notes: Stick electrodes and TIG rods sold separately (ESAB Sureweld, Lincoln Techalloy).

name: solder
definition: fusible alloy for soldering.
notes: Kester solder wire series 44, 245 and 24-7068.

name: reloading die
definition: die for a reloading press.
notes: Die sets for Hornady, Lee and RCBS presses sold as reloading dies.
